mentions.name: Mindscope 2
mentions.description: A visual thought-organization app for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS that combines a Scapple-style visual text canvas with Workflowy-style hierarchical focusing, letting users capture and organize their thoughts. Built from scratch in SwiftUI, and submitted to Apple for review.
mentions.problem: Written mainly as a personal tool to organize the author's thoughts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://mindscopeapp.com - Mindscope 2 (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS)

Just submitted it to Apple for review this past weekend... basically Scapple's visual text canvas meets Workflowy's hierarchical focusing. I mainly wrote the app for myself to organize my thoughts. Very happy with how it has turned out.

mentions.name: Mindscope 2
mentions.description: Mindscope 2 is a hierarchical text canvas app for iOS and macOS for organizing thoughts and taking notes. Version 2 is a SwiftUI rewrite of the original, adding features like reminders and deep linking. It is currently in TestFlight beta, nearing release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Mindscope 2 : https://mindscopeapp.com (iOS / macOS)

A hierarchical text canvas for organizing thoughts and taking notes. I wrote v1 years ago and now spent about year rewriting it in SwiftUI and adding all my dream features like reminders, deep linking, and lots more. Currently in TestFlight beta, nearing release.
